items.text: Packers WR Christian Watson ruled out after being evaluated for concussion following sideline hit (earlier questionable with thigh, returned briefly); Rams S Kamren Kinchens ejected on the play. Higbee also ruled out chest for Rams.
items.why: Concussion evaluation after hit; previously thigh issue in same game.
items.implication: Immediate target/snap boost to remaining Packers WRs in ongoing game; Watson out rest of contest.
items.opportunity: Increased routes/targets for Jayden Reed and other GB pass-catchers.

items.text: Chiefs officially ruled out RB Kenneth Walker III for Thursday Night vs Bills due to groin injury; rookie Emmett Johnson will start in his place for the third straight game.
items.why: Groin injury; limited then ruled out after Wednesday activity.
items.implication: Handcuff/backup elevated to starter role for TNF; Walker owners need pivot.
items.opportunity: Full backfield opportunity for KC RB2/handcuff with Walker out third straight.

items.text: 49ers QB Brock Purdy did not practice Wednesday with ankle injury suffered Sunday night vs Vikings; day-to-day per reports.
items.why: Ankle sprain from Week 11; DNP Wednesday.
items.implication: Monitor Friday practice/report; potential limited or backup contingency for SF.
items.opportunity: If sits, elevated role for SF backup QB and possible run-game lean.

items.text: Berry LOVES Bucky Irving this week: since Week 5 only Gibbs and CMC have averaged more PPG among RBs; gets Carolina matchup.
items.why: Elite recent PPG (top-3 RB since W5) + soft CAR matchup.
items.implication: Strong start/sit lock as RB1 this week.
items.opportunity: High snap/carry/target expectation vs weak run D.

items.text: Jaguars RB Bhayshul Tuten did not practice Wednesday due to foot/ankle injuries (re-aggravated in Week 11 loss); ETR flagged injury resurfacing.
items.why: Lingering foot/ankle; stepped on late Week 11, nothing 'too bad' but DNP and priority to get healthy.
items.implication: Game-time or OUT risk vs TEN; monitor rest of week practice.
items.opportunity: If OUT/INACTIVE, next-man-up (e.g. Rodriguez/handcuffs) full opportunity in JAX backfield.

items.text: Berry 10 Facts: Derrick Henry target share jumped from <6% (1.3 rec/g) first 9 games to 12% and 4.5 receptions in 2 games with Jacoby Brissett; significantly raises PPR floor.
items.why: QB change increased checkdowns/targets to Henry.
items.implication: Safer PPR RB1/2 with receiving upside holding.
items.opportunity: Elevated target share + red-zone/goal-line role sustained.

items.text: ETR Week 12 preview: Puka Nacua and Terrance Ferguson out for the season (Nacua post-MCL surgery/IR + suspension context; Ferguson ankle/hamstring).
items.why: MCL surgery; expected out rest of regular season (months recovery).
items.implication: Permanent void in LAR WR corps; Adams still IR too; volume to remaining WRs/TEs/Corum.
items.opportunity: Sustained target/snap share increase for other Rams pass-catchers and RB Blake Corum usage.

items.text: ETR: Colts cut Daniel Jones; Anthony Richardson set to start (confirmed by coach for Week 12 vs Giants).
items.why: Jones waived after poor play; AR named starter.
items.implication: Mobile QB upside changes Colts offense; potential boost to RBs/TEs via designed runs/scrambles; weapons depleted.
items.opportunity: Rushing opportunity expansion for Colts skill players under dual-threat QB.

items.text: Berry has Bo Nix on HATE list this week: expects heavy Jonah Coleman vs Pittsburgh; insufficient Nix rushing to compensate; outside top 20 QBs.
items.why: Matchup projects run-heavy (Coleman); Nix rushing upside not enough.
items.implication: Sit/stream elsewhere; low-end QB2 or worse.

items.text: Levitan on Travis Etienne (citing Graziano): could see disappointing snaps and routes down the stretch but reasonably high carry count; favorable ARZ/ATL in Weeks 16/17.
items.why: Role evolution post-team changes; data on snaps/routes vs carries.
items.implication: Carry-based floor viable but limited receiving upside; strong late-season schedule keeps relevant.
items.opportunity: Volume carries in favorable playoff matchups; monitor actual snap/route share weekly.

items.text: Berry 10 Facts: Since Rico Dowdle return Week 6, Jaylen Warren only 51% of PIT rush attempts, <10% target share in 3/5 games; ranks RB20 utilization; mid-to-low RB2 now (Mason Rudolph may help but view as downgrade).
items.why: Split backfield with Dowdle reducing carries and targets.
items.implication: Lower weekly floor/ceiling; flex rather than locked starter.

items.text: Berry 10 Facts: With Kyle Monangai back Week 11, D'Andre Swift 47% snap rate, 39% rush attempts, <10% targets in 4/5 games Monangai active; mid-to-low RB2 rather than prior RB1.
items.implication: Role contraction; start with caution or as flex.

items.text: Berry 10 Facts: Ladd McConkey in return saw season-high 38% target share and 20.7 FP; when >=20% share averages 17.5 PPG (only 3rd game >50% snaps); solid if healthy.
items.why: Immediate high target share on return.
items.implication: WR2/flex viability if health holds; monitor snaps.
items.opportunity: Sustained high target/route share in LAC offense.

items.text: Berry 10 Facts: Trey McBride 39% target share (19 targets) over past 2 weeks with backup QBs but aDOT only 3 yards, 1/19 targets 10+ air yards; 6.5 YPR, 11.8 PPG; volume keeps top-5 TE PPR but not elite prior form.
items.why: High volume but short aDOT under new QBs vs prior Brissett production.
items.implication: Reliable TE1 floor via targets but lower ceiling/YPR; don't expect prior upside.
items.opportunity: Continued high target share regardless of QB.
